game.name: Fight Night Champion (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Fight Night Champion is a boxing game for Xbox 360. Play as a variety of boxers, from Filipino Manny Pacquiao to Briton Ricky Hatton. The game features free-to-play fights, online multiplayer, a fully scripted Champion mode and a Career mode where you can create your own boxer and improve each of his moves over 20 levels.
